DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お手元の証明書についてのご相談ですか。提出先の案内もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to discuss the certificate you have? Do you also have the instructions from the organization receiving it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 去年受け取った証明書があります。案内に「三か月以内に発行」と見えるのですが、これから三か月以内に提出すればよいのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 去年の証明書を示し、三か月以内に発行を今後三か月以内の提出と解してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a certificate issued last year. The instructions seem to say 'issued within three months.' Does that mean I should submit it within the next three months?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show last year's certificate and ask whether 'issued within three months' means submission within the next three months. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 「発行」と「提出」は違う言葉です。この部分は、証明書が発行された時期について書いてあるようですが、全文を確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: 'Issued' and 'submitted' are different words. This part seems to concern when the certificate was issued. Can we check the full text?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 写真の右側が切れています。提出日から数えるのか、申込日から数えるのか、その先の文が見えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 案内写真が切れ、期間を提出日と申込日のどちらから数えるか不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The right side of the photo is cut off. I cannot see the rest explaining whether to count from the submission date or the application date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the instruction photo is cut off and you do not know whether the period is counted from submission or application. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 期間の基準は、この写真だけでは決められません。提出先に案内の全文を送ってもらいましょう。証明書の名称は一致していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: This photo alone cannot establish the reference date. Ask the receiving organization to send the full instructions. Does the certificate's name match?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 名称は同じように見えますが、必要な記載事項までは確認していません。発行日の条件と一緒に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 名称だけ似ているが必要記載は未確認で、発行日条件とともに聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The name looks the same, but I have not checked the required entries. I want to ask about those along with the issue-date condition.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that only the name looks similar, the required entries are unchecked, and you want to ask about them and the issue-date condition. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その二点を確認してから申請内容を整理しましょう。古い証明書は、内容を見るための参考としてお持ちいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us clarify the application after checking those two points. You may bring the old certificate as a reference for its contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 古いものを捨てずに参考として残します。ただ、新しく取れば何でもよいとは考えず、必要な記載事項も先に確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 古い証明書は参考に残し、新規発行でも記載事項を先に確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will keep the old one as a reference rather than discard it. But I will not assume any newly issued certificate will do; I will check the required entries first too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will retain the old certificate for reference and check required entries before requesting a new one too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。全文や回答が届いたら、どの条件が確認できたかわかるようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. When the full instructions or answer arrive, make it clear which conditions have been confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 発行日の基準、提出期限、必要な記載事項を三つに分けて控えます。今日は枚数を決めて発行申請せず、回答後に相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発行日基準・提出期限・記載事項を分けて控え、発行は回答後に相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will separately record the issue-date reference, submission deadline, and required entries. Today I will not decide the number of copies and apply for issuance; I will consult after the answer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will record the issue-date reference, submission deadline, and required entries separately and consult about issuance after the answer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。今日は条件の整理までにしましょう。案内の全文と古い証明書を、次回の相談にお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Today let us just organize the conditions. Bring the full instructions and old certificate to your next consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 薬の欄に「なし」とありますが、記入について確認したいことがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: The medicine field says 'none.' Is there anything you want to check about filling it in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 「常用薬」は毎日飲む薬だと思って、なしにしました。ときどき買って飲む頭痛薬のことも伝えたほうがよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 常用薬を毎日の薬と解してなしにしたが、時々使う頭痛薬も伝えるべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought 'regular medication' meant medicine taken every day, so wrote none. Should I also mention headache medicine I sometimes buy and take?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you interpreted regular medication as daily medicine and wrote none, and ask whether to report occasional headache medicine too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 毎日ではない薬も、診察で確認できるようにお伝えください。どんなときに、いつ使いましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please also mention non-daily medicine so it can be checked during the examination. In what circumstances and when did you use it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 頭が痛いときだけです。最後はおとといの夕方に飲みました。今ここで薬の名前は思い出せません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 頭痛時だけ使い、最後はおととい夕方だが名前は思い出せないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only when I have a headache. The last time was the evening before yesterday. I cannot remember its name here now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you use it only for headaches, last took it the evening before yesterday, and cannot remember its name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 名前が不明なことも記録しましょう。箱や説明の写真など、確認できる情報はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us record that the name is unknown too. Do you have information we can check, such as a photo of the box or instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 箱の写真は携帯にあります。ただ、一度に何錠飲んだかは覚えていないので、写真の説明を見て、その数だったと書かないほうがよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 箱の写真はあるが実際の錠数は不明で、説明の数を自分の服用数と記さないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a photo of the box on my phone. But I do not remember how many tablets I actually took, so I should not use the instruction photo to write that I took that number, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have the box photo but do not know the actual tablet count, and confirm you will not record the instructed number as your own dose. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、実際に飲んだ数が不明なら、そのままお知らせください。説明に書いてある数と、飲んだ数は同じとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Correct. If you do not know the number you actually took, tell us that. The number in the instructions is not necessarily the number you took.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、写真を見せて、最後に飲んだ日時は言います。実際の錠数は不明と伝えるので、わかる部分だけ一緒に記録してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 写真と最終日時を示し、錠数不明を保ったまま既知情報だけ記録の補助を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will show the photo and tell you when I last took it. I will say the actual tablet count is unknown; could you help record only the known information?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the photo and last-use date and time, preserve the unknown tablet count, and request help recording only known information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。薬を使ったこと、わかる日時と不明な数を分けます。頭痛の状態や薬の使い方の相談は、医師にお伝えしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. We will separate having used medicine, the known time, and the unknown count. Tell the doctor your questions about the headache and medicine use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 診察でも、毎日ではないけれど使った薬があると説明します。なしの記載はそのままにせず、不明な数は推測しないで相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: なしを訂正して時々使った薬を医師に説明し、不明な数は推測せず相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: During the examination I will explain that I used medicine, though not every day. I will not leave 'none' unchanged, and will consult without guessing the unknown count.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will correct none, explain occasional medicine use to the doctor, and consult without guessing the unknown count. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その情報を問診に追記します。薬の写真も診察で見せられるようお手元に用意し、症状と合わせて医師にお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will add that to the questionnaire. Keep the medicine photo ready to show during the examination and tell the doctor along with your symptoms.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのような連絡が来ましたか。今、相手が近くにいる状況ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: What message did you receive? Is the other person near you now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 近くにはいません。友人と同じ名前と写真の相手から、急いでお金を送ってほしいというメッセージが来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 相手は近くにおらず、友人と同じ表示名と写真から急な送金要求が来たと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: They are not nearby. Someone with my friend's display name and photo sent a message urgently asking me to send money.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the person is not nearby and you received an urgent money request from someone with your friend's display name and photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じ表示でも、その友人本人と確認できたとは限りません。返信や送金はしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: The same display does not necessarily confirm it is your friend. Have you replied or sent money?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 「どうしたの」とだけ返しました。お金は送っていません。その後、別の連絡先へ移るよう言われましたが、まだ移っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: どうしたのとだけ返信し、送金も別連絡先への移動もまだしていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I only replied 'What happened?' I have not sent money. They then told me to move to another contact, but I have not done that yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you replied only 'What happened?' and have neither sent money nor moved to another contact. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今のやり取りを消さずに見せてください。以前から知っている友人の連絡先は、別にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please show the conversation without deleting it. Do you have another contact for your friend that you already knew?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 前から電話帳に入っている番号があります。メッセージに新しく書かれた番号とは違います。そちらで本人に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 以前からの電話帳の番号が新たな文面の番号と違い、既知の番号で本人確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: There is a number that has been in my contacts for a long time. It differs from the new number written in the message. I want to verify with my friend through the known number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the old number in your contacts differs from the newly messaged number, and you want to verify the person using the known number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その二つを区別して記録しましょう。相手は支払いの期限も指定していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us record those two separately. Did the sender specify a payment deadline too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日中と言われています。でも、友人と確認できないまま送るつもりはありません。急がされている文面も残して見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今日中と迫られているが確認なしに送らず、その要求文も保存すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: They said today. But I will not send money without confirming it is my friend. I will retain and show the message pressuring me to hurry too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say they demand payment today but you will not send without verification, and will preserve the urgent request too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 文面と時刻、相手の表示がわかる記録を確認します。友人のアカウントに何が起きたかは、ここではまだ断定できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check records showing the wording, times, and sender display. We cannot yet determine here what happened to your friend's account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 本人からの連絡かは未確認として相談します。会話の記録を残し、以前の番号で確認します。表示名だけで本物と決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人か未確認として記録を示し、以前の番号で確認して表示名だけで判断しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will consult with the sender's identity unconfirmed. I will keep the conversation and check through the old number. I will not decide it is genuine from the display name alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show records with the identity unconfirmed, say you will check using the old number and not rely only on the display name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、保存した記録から順に伺います。新しい連絡先へ移ったり金銭を送ったりする前に、確認できたことと未確認のことを分けてお話しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let us go through the saved records in order. Before moving to the new contact or sending money, explain confirmed facts separately from unconfirmed ones.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 荷物の送り方についてですね。中身と送料の支払い希望を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: About sending a parcel: please tell me the contents and how you want postage paid.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 中身はタオルです。家族への贈り物なので私が送料を払いたいですが、今日は現金をあまり持っていません。着払いなら私が後で払えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 贈答タオルの送料は自分で払いたいが現金が少なく、着払いで自分が後払いできるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Towels. They are a gift to family, so I want to pay postage, but have little cash today. With receiver-paid postage, can I pay later myself?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to pay postage for gift towels but have little cash, and ask whether receiver-paid postage lets you pay later yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ここでいう着払いは、受け取る方に送料をお支払いいただく方法です。差し出した方が後から払うという意味ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Receiver-paid postage here means the person receiving it pays the postage. It does not mean the sender pays afterward.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家族に払ってもらうつもりはありませんでした。では着払いにはせず、私が払う方法を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族負担の意図はなく着払いをやめ、自分が払う方法を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I did not intend to make my family pay. Then I will not choose receiver-paid postage; I want to check a way to pay myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you did not intend to charge family, will not use receiver-paid postage, and want a method for paying yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 差出人が支払う方法を、大きさや重さと合わせて確認しましょう。国内への荷物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check sender-paid methods along with the size and weight. Is it a domestic parcel?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 国内です。住所はこのメモにあります。中にはタオル三枚だけで、まだ送料は払っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 国内宛メモを示し、タオル三枚のみで送料未払いと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, domestic. The address is on this note. There are only three towels inside, and I have not paid postage yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the domestic-address note and explain there are only three towels and postage is unpaid. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 内容を確認しました。まず料金をご案内し、この窓口で利用できる支払方法もご説明します。今ここで発送を確定しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Contents confirmed. First we will explain the price and payment methods accepted at this counter. Will you finalize dispatch now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 料金と使える支払方法を聞いてから決めたいです。足りなければ、着払いに変えるのではなく、後日また持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 料金と支払方法を先に聞き、不足なら着払いでなく後日持参にすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to decide after hearing the price and accepted methods. If I am short, I will bring it another day rather than change to receiver-paid postage.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will hear price and methods first, and bring it later if short rather than switch to receiver-paid postage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。まだ受付は確定せず、比較用に条件を確認します。ご家族には到着日を約束していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. We will not finalize acceptance yet, only check conditions for comparison. Have you promised your family an arrival date?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まだ約束していません。今日送れると決めず、支払方法が決まってから、配達の見込みも聞いて家族に連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 到着日は未約束で、今日発送とは決めず支払方法後に配達見込みを確認して家族へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Not yet. I will not assume dispatch today; after deciding payment, I will ask the delivery estimate and tell my family.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say no arrival date is promised; do not assume dispatch today, but check delivery prospects after payment is decided and tell family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、料金と支払方法のご案内から始めます。着払いの意味とは分けて、ご自身が負担できる方法を確認してからお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let us begin with the price and payment methods. Separate them from the meaning of receiver-paid postage and choose after checking a method you can cover yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込の金額と費用についてですね。相手へ送る金額はいくらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: About the transfer amount and costs: how much will you send the recipient?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 請求書は三万円です。手持ちも三万円ですが、この中から手数料を払って、残りを送ればよいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 請求三万円と手持ち三万円を示し、手数料を引いた残額を送るつもりだったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The bill is 30,000 yen, and I have 30,000 yen. I thought I should pay the fee from that and send the remainder.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the 30,000-yen bill and 30,000 yen available, and explain you intended to send the remainder after deducting the fee. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 請求された額と、費用を含む支出は分けて考えましょう。今回はこの方法だと、振込額三万円とは別に手数料三百三十円がかかります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Separate the billed amount from total spending including costs. With this method now, the 30,000-yen transfer requires a separate 330-yen fee.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 相手に三万円を送るなら、合計三万三百三十円が必要なのですね。私の手持ちでは三百三十円足りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 三万円送る総額は三万三百三十円で、三百三十円不足すると計算して確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: So sending the recipient 30,000 yen requires 30,330 yen altogether. I am 330 yen short.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Calculate and confirm that sending 30,000 yen requires 30,330 yen total and you are 330 yen short. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。請求書より少ない額を送ってよいかは、この窓口では決められません。受取先の情報も、請求書で確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Correct. This counter cannot decide whether paying less than the bill is acceptable. Can you also check the recipient details on the bill?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 銀行名、支店、口座の種類と番号、受取人名が書かれています。金額を二万九千六百七十円に減らして送ることは、今はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 請求書に振込先情報があり、二万九千六百七十円へ勝手に減らして今送らないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: It lists the bank, branch, account type and number, and recipient name. I will not reduce the amount to 29,670 yen and send it now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the bill lists recipient details and you will not arbitrarily reduce it to 29,670 yen and send now. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。まだ振込は実行していません。費用を含めて用意し直すか、ほかの利用方法の条件を先に確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. No transfer has been executed yet. You may prepare the total including costs again, or first check conditions for other methods.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日はこの方法で実行せず、必要な総額を用意し直したいです。次に来るときも、手数料が同じか改めて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今回は実行せず総額を用意し直し、次回の手数料も再確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not execute this method today, and want to prepare the required total again. Next time I will also recheck whether the fee is still the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not transfer this time, will prepare the total again, and recheck the fee next time too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その際に方法、費用、振込先を再確認しましょう。今日の相談を、送金済みと受取先へ伝えないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will then recheck method, cost, and recipient. Please do not tell the recipient today's consultation means money has been sent.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 相手には、まだ送金していないと伝えます。請求額三万円と総支出三万三百三十円を分けてメモし、受付を確定しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未送金を相手に伝え、請求額と総支出を別に控えて受付を確定しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell them it has not been sent. I will separately note the 30,000-yen bill and 30,330-yen total spending, and will not finalize acceptance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will tell the recipient no transfer was made, note the bill and total separately, and not finalize acceptance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、今日は振込を実行せずに終えます。次回はご用意した総額と、その時点の条件を確認してからお手続きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will finish today without executing a transfer. Next time check your prepared total and the conditions then before proceeding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 二つのかごがありますが、お会計は一緒でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have two baskets. Shall we put them on one bill?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 分けてください。こちらの日用品は仕事用、パンと牛乳は自宅用です。レシートも別々に必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 仕事用日用品と自宅用食品を示し、会計とレシートを分けてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Please separate them. These household goods are for work; the bread and milk are for home. I need separate receipts too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show household goods for work and food for home, and request separate bills and receipts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お支払い前なので、二回に分けてお会計します。袋も別になさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Since you have not paid yet, we will make two transactions. Would you like separate bags too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、仕事用はこの青い袋、自宅用は布袋に入れます。新しい袋は不要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 仕事用は青い袋、自宅用は布袋で新しい袋は不要と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. Work items go in this blue bag, home items in the cloth bag. No new bags are needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say work items go in the blue bag, home items in the cloth bag, and no new bags are needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず仕事用が六百八十円です。お支払い方法はいかがなさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: First, work items are 680 yen. How will you pay?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 仕事用はこの千円札で払います。先にこの分のレシートとおつりを受け取ってから、自宅用の支払いをします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 仕事用六百八十円を千円で払い、そのレシートとおつりを先に受け取ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will use this 1,000-yen note. I will receive that receipt and change first, then pay for the home items.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will pay 1,000 yen for the 680-yen work items and receive that receipt and change first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 三百二十円のおつりと仕事用のレシートです。続いて自宅用は四百二十円ですが、こちらも現金ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here are 320 yen change and the work receipt. Home items are 420 yen next; cash for these too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、今度は五百円を出します。仕事用のおつりは別の封筒にしまったので、自宅用とは混ぜません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自宅用四百二十円に五百円を出し、仕事用のおつりは別に収納済みと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, this time I will give 500 yen. I put the work change in another envelope, so will not mix it with home spending.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Pay 500 yen for the 420-yen home items and say the work change is already stored separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 八十円のおつりと、自宅用のレシートです。二つのレシートをお持ちになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here are 80 yen change and the home receipt. Do you have both receipts?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、六百八十円と四百二十円の二枚を受け取りました。品物も袋ごとに分けてから帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 六百八十円と四百二十円の二枚を受け取り、品物も二袋に分けて帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I received the 680-yen and 420-yen receipts. I will also separate the purchases into their bags before leaving.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you received both receipts, 680 and 420 yen, and will divide the items between two bags before leaving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 両方のお会計が済みました。二つの袋とレシートをお忘れにならないよう、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Both payments are complete. Remember both bags and receipts, and take care going home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 散歩の経路ですね。どちらの道をお考えですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: About your walking route: which path are you considering?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人とこの小道を通るつもりでした。でも地図の横に点検中とあります。短い区間なら通れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人と通る予定の小道が点検中だが短い区間だけ通れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend and I planned to take this small path. But beside the map it says under inspection. Can we use just a short stretch?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you and your friend may use only a short part of the path marked under inspection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日はその小道全体が通行止めです。短い区間だけでも入らず、開いている経路をご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Today the entire path is closed. Do not enter even for a short section; use open routes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: さっき二人がそちらへ入ったように見えたので、歩行者も通れると思ってしまいました。利用できる根拠にはならないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 他の二人が入ったように見えて通行可と思ったが根拠にならないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought pedestrians could use it because it looked as though two people entered earlier. That does not establish that it is available, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say seeing two people apparently enter made you think it was open, but confirm that this is not evidence of permission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 見かけた方がどなたかは、ここでは確認できません。表示に従ってください。今回はどのくらいの散歩を希望していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot determine here who those people were. Follow the signs. How much walking would you like today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 遠くへ行く必要はありません。友人と話しながら少し歩き、同じ入口へ戻りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 遠出でなく友人と話しながら少し歩き、同じ入口へ戻りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: We do not need to go far. I want to walk a little while talking with my friend and return to the same entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want a short walk talking with your friend, rather than going far, and return to the same entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それなら、開いている広場の周囲を回る案があります。小道へ続く分岐には進みません。途中のベンチも使えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then you could go around the open plaza. Do not take the branch leading to the small path. Benches along the way can also be used.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 広場の周囲に変えます。通行止めの小道を避けて入口へ戻る向きを、図で示してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 広場周囲へ変更し、閉鎖小道を避けて入口へ戻る向きの図示を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will change to going around the plaza. Could you show on the diagram the direction back to the entrance while avoiding the closed path?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Change to around the plaza and request a diagram of the way back to the entrance avoiding the closed path. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらが戻る向きです。友人の方が小道側で待っているなら、先に変更を伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: This is the direction back. If your friend is waiting on the small-path side, tell them the change first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人には広場の入口で会おうと連絡します。点検が早く終わると期待せず、今日は開いている範囲で散歩します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人に広場入口で会うと伝え、点検の早期終了を当てにせず開放範囲だけ歩くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will message my friend to meet at the plaza entrance. I will not expect inspection to finish early; today we will walk only in the open area.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will tell your friend to meet at the plaza entrance and walk only in open areas without relying on an early end to inspection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: この図をお持ちください。小道は通行できる案内が出るまで入らず、広場の周囲の経路でお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Take this diagram. Do not enter the path until guidance says it is open; enjoy the route around the plaza.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 放送を聞いてお立ち止まりでしたね。ご予定の列車についてお尋ねでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You stopped after hearing the announcement. Are you asking about your planned train?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 遅れているという放送が聞こえました。自分の予定も遅れると思い、今見ている表示の時間だけ待つつもりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 放送と表示の遅れを自分の予定列車にも当てはめて待つと思っていると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I heard an announcement about a delay. I assumed my train would be delayed too and plan to wait just the time shown on the display I am looking at.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you applied the announcement and displayed delay to your own planned train and intend to wait accordingly. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず行先と方向を合わせましょう。お手元の予定では、どちら向きの列車をご利用ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: First match the destination and direction. Which direction is the train on your itinerary?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 予定の画面はこちらです。見ていた表示とは方向の文字が違います。反対方向の案内を見ていたようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予定画面と方向の文字が異なり、反対方向の遅れを見ていたと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here is my planned journey screen. Its direction wording differs from the display I was watching. It seems I was looking at the opposite direction's information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your itinerary's direction differs from the display and you were viewing the opposite direction's delay. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 方向が違う表示の時間を、そのままご自身の列車に当てはめず確認しましょう。予定の列車が分かる部分をお示しいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do not directly apply a different direction's displayed time to your train; let us check. Could you show the part identifying your planned train?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この列車名と行先の部分です。放送の一部だけで全部同じと思わず、この列車についての情報を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 列車名と行先を示し、放送の一部で全て同じとせず当該列車の情報を求める。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: This train name and destination. I do not want to assume all trains are the same based on part of an announcement; I want information about this train.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show train name and destination and seek that train's information without treating all trains alike from part of an announcement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 対象を絞って現在の案内を確認します。確認前に、到着を待っている方へ伝えたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will focus on that train and check current guidance. Before confirmation, is there anything you want to tell those waiting for you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 迎えに来る家族に、今は自分の列車の状況を確認中だと連絡します。反対方向に出ていた遅れを、到着の遅れとして伝えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 迎えの家族に状況確認中と連絡し、逆方向の遅れを自分の到着遅れとして伝えないと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will tell the family picking me up that I am checking my train's status. I will not report the opposite direction's delay as a delay to my arrival.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will tell the family collecting you that you are checking, and not present the opposite direction's delay as your arrival delay. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのうえで、対象の列車の案内を見てお考えください。ご自身でも、表示のどこを照合するか確かめておきますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then decide based on the information for the relevant train. Would you also like to check which display fields to compare yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 行先、方向、列車名を合わせて見ます。情報が分かってから家族へ伝え直し、今の段階では到着時刻を決めつけません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 行先・方向・列車名を照合し、確認後に家族へ更新して現段階では到着を断定しないと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will match destination, direction, and train name. Once I have the information I will update my family, and will not assume an arrival time now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will compare destination, direction, and train name, update family after checking, and not assert an arrival time yet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 対象を取り違えない確認ができましたね。こちらで今の列車の案内を確認しますので、ご予定の画面をそのままお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have established how to avoid confusing the trains. I will check your train's current guidance, so keep showing your itinerary screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 相談の予約についてですね。何件のご相談で、どなたがお越しになるご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: About booking a consultation: how many matters, and who plans to attend?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私と友人の二人分でお願いしたいです。届いた通知の説明を聞きたいのですが、日本語だけだと不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通知の説明を日本語だけで聞くのが不安で、本人と友人の二人分の相談予約を希望する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to book for me and my friend, two people. I want the notice I received explained, but worry about hearing it only in Japanese.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request a consultation reservation for yourself and your friend because you are worried about hearing the notice explained only in Japanese. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご友人にも別の手続きの相談がおありですか。それとも、説明を聞くお手伝いでご同行の予定でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does your friend have a separate procedural question, or will they accompany you to help understand the explanation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人は言葉の手伝いです。相談する通知は私の一件だけで、友人自身の申請はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人は言葉の補助で本人の通知一件のみ、友人自身の申請はないと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: My friend will help with language. There is only one consultation, my notice, and no application of my friend's own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your friend is language support, there is only your notice, and your friend has no application. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 本人のご相談一件と、付き添いのご希望として伺います。ご希望の言語や、説明で特に心配な点もございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will treat it as one consultation for you with a request for a companion. What language do you prefer, and what concerns you about the explanation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ベトナム語です。友人に任せきりにせず、私にも分かるよう、難しい所は短く区切って説明してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ベトナム語を希望し、友人任せにせず本人にも短く区切った説明を求める。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Vietnamese. I do not want to leave everything to my friend; please explain difficult parts in short sections so I can understand too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request Vietnamese and explanations broken into short sections for your own understanding, rather than leaving everything to your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 同行や言語支援の方法は担当へ確認します。相談できる候補を伺うため、お二人の都合も分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check accompaniment and language support methods with the staff. To find possible consultation times, do you know both your availability?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私は平日の午後、友人は仕事が休みの日なら来られます。勤務表を見て、二人が合う候補を出したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人は平日午後、友人は休みの日なので勤務表で合う候補日を出すと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can come weekday afternoons, and my friend on days off. I want to check the work schedule and offer dates that suit us both.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you can come weekday afternoons and your friend on days off, and will check the work schedule for mutually suitable dates. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 日時や同行方法は、希望を出しただけでは確定しません。担当へ伝える内容を、今の区別でまとめられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Requesting dates and accompaniment does not confirm them. Can you organize what to tell the staff using those distinctions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 本人の通知一件、友人は言葉の付き添い、希望はベトナム語と区切った説明です。候補日をそろえ、受付方法と同行の条件を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人一件・友人付き添い・言語と説明の希望を整理し、候補日と受付・同行条件を確認すると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: One notice for me; my friend is a language companion; I want Vietnamese and explanations in short sections. I will prepare possible dates and check reception methods and accompaniment conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Organize your one matter, friend as companion, and language and explanation preferences; say you will check possible dates and reception and companion conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご本人と同行者の役割が整理できましたね。その内容を担当へ引き継ぎ、相談の受付についてご案内します。通知はお手元にお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your roles are clear now. We will pass this to the staff and guide you on accepting the consultation. Keep the notice with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 会計後の書類についてですね。職場から用紙を渡されているのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: About documents after payment: has your workplace given you a form?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この用紙を職場へ出すよう言われました。早くそろえたいので、空いている所を全部自分で書けばよいと思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 職場へ早く出すため用紙の空欄を全部自分で書こうと思っていると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: They told me to submit this form. I want to prepare it quickly, so think I should fill in every blank myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you intend to fill in every blank yourself to submit the workplace form quickly. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 欄の見出しを分けて見ましょう。こちらは本人記入欄、こちらは医師記入欄とありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us distinguish the field headings. This is the section for you, and this one says for the doctor.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 医師の欄まで私が埋める物ではないのですね。本人の欄も、分からない所を想像で書かずに聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 医師欄は本人が埋めず、本人欄も不明点は推測せず質問したいと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I should not fill the doctor's section myself. For my own section too, I want to ask about unknown parts rather than guess.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will not fill the doctor's section, and want to ask about unknown parts in your own section rather than guess. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人の欄の質問と、医師の記載が必要な書類の相談を分けて伺います。提出先から、何を記載してほしいと言われていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will take your questions about your section separately from consultation on documents needing a doctor's entries. What did the recipient ask to be written?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この用紙を使うことだけ聞きました。病名や休む期間について、職場が求める項目はまだ確認できていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 指定用紙の使用以外に病名や休む期間の記載要件は職場へ未確認だと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I was only told to use this form. I have not checked the workplace's requirements for the diagnosis or the period off work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that aside from using the specified form, you have not checked workplace requirements for diagnosis or time off. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な項目を提出先に確認し、その回答と用紙を文書担当へお示しください。提出する時期についても、指定はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Check the required fields with the recipient and show their answer and the form to document staff. Was a submission time specified too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 来週までと言われましたが、何曜日かは聞き直したいです。こちらでいつ受け取れるかも、申請前に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 来週までの具体的な曜日を聞き直し、施設の受取時期を申請前に相談したいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: They said by next week, but I want to ask again which day. I also want to discuss when I could receive it here before applying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will ask the specific weekday meant by next week and discuss the facility's collection timing before applying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 提出先の希望日と、この施設で発行できるかや時期は、別に確認しましょう。費用についても文書担当がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us separately check the recipient's desired day and whether and when this facility can issue it. Document staff will also explain the cost.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 医師欄に自分で書き込まず、用紙を保管します。職場に項目と具体的な期限を聞き、費用と受取時期を担当へ相談してから申請します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46224-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 医師欄へ自己記入せず用紙を保管し、職場の項目・具体期限と担当の費用・受取時期を確認後に申請すると述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
